card.name: Linking words after drug names in warnings
card.fires_on: Small linking words right after a drug name or a pregnancy phrase in label warnings, especially "if" in "used during pregnancy only if", and "can", "is", "for" after a brand name or Monitor.

modes.label: Pregnancy-use condition
modes.description: The word "if" after "should be used during pregnancy only".
modes.example: Nicardipine hydrochloride capsules should be used during pregnancy only<< if>> the potential benefit justifies the potential risk

modes.label: Word after brand name
modes.description: A verb or bracket directly after an uppercase brand drug name in warnings.
modes.example: Immune-Mediated Pneumonitis LIBTAYO<< can>> cause immune-mediated pneumonitis.

modes.label: The phrase "Monitor for"
modes.description: The word "for" after "Monitor" in warnings and precautions headings.
modes.example: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Suicidal Behavior and Ideation: Monitor<< for>> suicidal thoughts or behavior ( 5.
